statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and transient neurological deficits
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
CPT 93271 cardiac event monitoring is indicated
The service is to detect intermittent arrhythmias that may be contributing to ischemic events
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the patient's current benefit plan
